scope: Titan character design, native animation and original audio; compatible framework update

character.concept: hydraulic siege colossus with long pile-driver arms and folding armored bastion

build_artifact_recovery.reason: Gradle compiled and signed APK42 successfully; final assembleRelease task failed only copying to redundant flutter-apk output due disk space. Recovered the complete signed APK from app/outputs/apk/release after CRC check. No build validation bypassed.

actual_main_game_pointer.client: Current main-game worker and compiled Flutter client, Chrome headless

performance.method: Old v39 Titan Rive vs new native Titan, both migrated to the same Flet1.1.2 / Flutter3.47.9; identical scenario cadence and font assets. Not an old-APK vs new-APK measurement.

before-workshop.measurement: Flutter FrameTiming, rolling 120 records; four initial reports excluded; duplicate vsync records removed from FPS
before-workshop.limitations: One desktop run, overlapping rolling windows. Does not establish Android FPS, thermal stability or long-session performance.

memory.measurement: Windows Chrome process-tree working/private bytes and CDP JS heap snapshots; includes browser/renderer overhead, not Android or Dart-only memory
